thread:
PagerDuty Bot: 🔔 Incident triggered: 502 errors observed on /v1/embeddings in us-west-2. Alert group: embeddings-prod-high-latency. Pg: ops-oncall.

Ops Oncall: I'm paged, looking now. Initial spike started ~10:02 UTC. Can someone from support hold until we know customer impact?

Emma Li: on it — I'll start collecting customer-facing notes and prepare a short ack for Zendesk. Any ETA on scope?

Sanjay Patel: backend shows a surge of 502s from the inference frontends to the model-serving pool; upstream connection resets. No autoscale events.

Maria Gomez: I can draft an Intercom message for affected workspaces. Keep it short: acknowledge, say we're investigating, give workaround if available.

Ops Oncall: Confirmed target: embeddings endpoints in us-west-2 only. No evidence of data loss. Rolling retries are failing; we have fallback routes but they're rate-limited.

Jen Park: tagging support playbook — here's an agent macro I put together to ack tickets quickly:

```
Hi, thanks for reporting this — we’re aware of an issue affecting the Embeddings endpoint in us-west-2 and are actively investigating.
We’ll update you within 30 minutes with next steps.
If you need an immediate workaround, try routing to us-east-1 (if your config permits) or retry after 1–2 minutes.
Apologies for the disruption.
— Redwood Support
```

Ops Oncall: good. I'll post a statuspage incident once we have a short impact statement. Can someone check if any SLA-bearing customers are currently degraded?

Emma Li: reaching out to two customers who have dedicated capacity in us-west-2 now. Will update thread.

Sanjay Patel: quick triage checklist for agents (put in chat for reuse):
1) Confirm customer region/model (ask "Which region is your project configured in?")
2) Collect request ids and sample timestamps
3) Ask if they can retry against a different region or model variant
4) If on Dedicated, advise we may route to fallback pool (we will follow up)
5) Apply the ack macro and tag incident #1837504321 in ticket

Maria Gomez: Intercom broadcast draft (concise):
"We’re investigating an issue causing 502 errors for embeddings in us-west-2. No data loss expected. Engineers are working on a fix; we’ll send updates here. If your workflow allows, try switching to us-east-1 as a temporary workaround."

Ops Oncall: Statuspage Bot — please create incident with impact = "Partial outage" and assign component "Embeddings API — us-west-2"

Statuspage Bot: Incident created: SP-9832. Public message set to "Investigating." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/SP-9832

Jen Park: I added a more detailed support macro for Zendesk with placeholders so agents can paste customer-specific info quickly:

```
[ACK] Hi {{customer_name}}, thanks for flagging this. We’re seeing 502 responses from the Embeddings API in us-west-2 for the last ~10 minutes. Our engineers have identified connection resets between frontends and the model pool.

Workarounds:
• If possible, change your request endpoint to us-east-1 or another region.
• If you're on Dedicated, tell us and we’ll attempt a fallback route for you.

We’ll follow up in this ticket when the incident is resolved or we have a significant update. Reference: incident SP-9832.
— {{agent_name}}, Redwood Support
```

Ops Oncall: thumbs up. Emma — did the two customers confirm impact?

Emma Li: One reported failures across all jobs (sent sample req id 0b3f2c). The other says scheduled jobs retried and succeeded after 3 attempts (so partial). Both asked for ETA.

Sanjay Patel: For mitigation: we’ve restarted a subset of inference workers and are draining connections from the flaky pool. If that doesn't recover in 10–15m we'll enable the fallback routing policy (will increase cost but restore service).

Maria Gomez: I'll queue the Intercom broadcast and include the workaround line. Also adding a note for account teams to DM any high-SLA customers.

Ops Oncall: Set update cadence. Next update in 20 minutes. If anyone needs to handoff, ping here and include summary + actions taken.

Emma Li: Writing a short internal comm template for customer success to DM enterprise accounts:

"Hi <name>,
We wanted to make you aware of a service disruption impacting embeddings in us-west-2. Our engineering team is currently investigating; we recommend switching to us-east-1 if that’s viable for your workload. We’ll keep you posted. — Emma (Redwood Support)"

Jen Park: Also adding a quick troubleshooting checklist agents can paste into replies:
• Confirm region + model
• Ask for request ids + timestamps
• Have they retried? (how many times)
• Can they switch region?
• Attach sample request/response if available

Statuspage Bot: Update posted: "Identified — Engineers are restarting affected workers and rolling traffic to fallback pools where possible. Customers may see increased error rates or latency. Next update in 20 minutes."

Ops Oncall: Follow-ups: 1) Ensure incident timeline notes restarts and fallback toggle, 2) post RCA stub in thread after resolved, 3) link tickets that reference SP-9832.

Maria Gomez: Broadcast sent, DM to enterprise teams queued.

Sanjay Patel: recovery hints — if fallback routing is enabled we should include cost advisory in comms: "Note: temporary routing to fallback pools may increase usage charges."

Emma Li: updated Zendesk macro to include that cost note.

Ops Oncall: ok handoff — I need to step off in 18 minutes. If statuspage escalates or errors spike above 20% please escalate to oncall2. Handing off to Sanjay for technical follow-through and Jen for support comms.

Sanjay Patel: acknowledged, taking technical lead.

Jen Park: acknowledged — taking support lead. I'll own customer replies and make final public messaging more detailed if we enable fallback.

PagerDuty Bot: Incident acknowledged by Sanjay Patel and Jen Park.

Emma Li: thanks — I'll keep monitoring ticket queue and consolidate any frequently asked questions into a follow-up doc for the post-incident notes.

Statuspage Bot: Final public update queued: "Investigating -> Monitoring. The restart and routing changes have reduced errors; we're continuing to monitor. Customers may see intermittent errors for a short window. A full update and timeline will be provided in the incident report."

(End of thread)
